title: Core Zod IDs, event envelope, and config schemas

stories.title: Define branded IDs, ratings, canonical events, and cursors
acceptance: Zod schemas define branded aggregate/context IDs and 0-100 rating primitives with inferred TypeScript types

A strict canonical aggregate event envelope validates deterministic event ID, aggregate identity, positive stream order, versions, logical time, command/idempotency/correlation identity, optional context, and typed payload
Race-feed cursor helpers distinguish aggregate event IDs from publication cursors and return stable invalid, ahead, and expired codes
stories.verify: npm run test --workspace @apex-hour/contracts && npm run typecheck

stories.title: Implement strict YAML and environment config resolution
acceptance: One strict Zod root schema and inferred AppConfig merge defaults then optional YAML then APEX_HOUR environment leaves with arrays replaced
YAML rejects duplicate keys, custom tags, aliases, expansion, oversized files, missing configured files, and unsafe values
Environment decoding accepts only schema-directed boolean, finite decimal, null, JSON array/object, or string values and rejects unknown prefixed variables
Final leaf provenance is retained and safe diagnostics do not echo arbitrary rejected values
stories.verify: npm run test --workspace @apex-hour/config && npm run typecheck

stories.title: Complete config metadata, redaction, path, and compatibility fixtures
acceptance: Schema metadata recursively marks secrets and filesystem-sensitive paths for redacted effective-config serialization
Production database, config, and backup paths resolve inside allowlisted roots while the named development-only override is rejected in production
Compatibility fixtures cover additive event fields, version material, nested arrays, URL credentials, embedded tokens, paths, parser failures, and every operations configuration boundary row
No duplicate handwritten public TypeScript shape exists where a Zod schema is authoritative
stories.verify: npm run test --workspace @apex-hour/contracts && npm run test --workspace @apex-hour/config && npm run typecheck && npm run check
